about.title: About Us
about.mainHeading: ARTEK ELEKTRONIK: A Reliable History, A Powerful Future
about.intro: Artek Elektronik, which stepped into the electronic components sector in 1987, has contributed to the development of the industry for over three decades as one of Turkey's leading import and export companies. The deep commercial experience we have gained since our establishment has made customer satisfaction and rapid supply our core priorities.

manufacturingStrength.heading: Our Manufacturing Strength: The 2008 Transformation
manufacturingStrength.content: Combining our industry experience with the increasing demand from our customers for specialized solutions, we began our manufacturing journey in 2008. With this transformation, Artek Elektronik evolved from being just a supplier to a solution partner with custom design and production capabilities.
manufacturingStrength.current: Today, in our modern facilities, we manufacture critical components such as high-frequency ferrite cores, bobbins, transformers, and inductors. Our production processes are meticulously managed in compliance with international quality standards.

expertise.heading: Our Areas of Expertise and Vision
expertise.intro: At Artek Elektronik, we offer specialized solutions to a wide range of sectors based on technical excellence. Our main areas of expertise include:
expertise.automotive: Automotive: In-vehicle electronic systems requiring high reliability.
expertise.lighting: Lighting: High energy efficiency LED driver and ballast solutions.
expertise.medical: Medical: Precise and stable power supply components.
expertise.agriculture: Agriculture: Industrial electronic applications resistant to harsh conditions.

vision.content: Our Vision is clear: Representing Turkey's manufacturing and export power, Artek Elektronik aims to become Turkey's number one exporter of high-frequency transformers and bobbins in the near future. In line with this goal, we continue to invest in technology and human resources, increasing our impact on the global market every day.
vision.closing: With the accumulation of experience from yesterday to today, Artek Elektronik will continue to shape the energy solutions of tomorrow.

ferritNuve.heroSubtitle: High-Quality Ferrite Cores Manufactured in Turkey
ferritNuve.heroDescription: Custom ferrite core solutions for high-frequency SMPS, LED drivers and industrial power electronics — EE, ETD, UU, RM and Toroid geometries available.
ferritNuve.whatIsText: A ferrite core is a ceramic magnetic material produced by sintering iron oxide (Fe₂O₃) with metal oxides such as zinc, nickel, or manganese at high temperatures. Its low-loss characteristic at high frequencies makes it widely used in SMPS transformers, EMI filters, inductors, and bobbin assemblies.
ferritNuve.why1Text: High magnetic permeability values enable maximum energy transfer in compact designs.
ferritNuve.why2Text: Core losses are minimized across the optimal operating frequency range of 100 kHz to 3 MHz.
ferritNuve.why3Text: Stable magnetic performance from -40°C to +125°C — ideal for critical industrial applications.
ferritNuve.why4Text: Production with custom dimensions and material composition alongside standard geometries.
ferritNuve.type1Desc: The most commonly used geometry. Standard solution for SMPS transformers and EMI filters.
ferritNuve.type2Desc: Round center-leg design optimized for high power density.
ferritNuve.type3Desc: Preferred form for large cross-section applications and power inductors.
ferritNuve.type4Desc: Excellent space optimization for compact PCB-mounted transformers.
ferritNuve.type5Desc: Lowest EMI emission and highest efficiency thanks to the closed magnetic circuit.
ferritNuve.type6Desc: Wide window area for high-current inductors and power transformers.
ferritNuve.ctaTitle: Get a Ferrite Core Quote for Your Project
ferritNuve.ctaText: Browse our standard product catalog or share your custom design requirements with our technical team.

bobin.heroDescription: High-temperature and high-voltage resistant plastic and polyamide bobbins in EE, ETD, EFD, PQ and RM series — standard and custom sizes. Fast delivery from Turkey.
bobin.whatIsText: A bobbin is an insulating body onto which copper windings are wound around a ferrite core. It mechanically fixes the winding arrangement in transformer and inductor production and can be directly mounted to a PCB via pins. Material selection is made based on operating temperature and voltage insulation requirements.
bobin.why1Text: UL94 V-0 approved material options suitable for 155°C and 180°C operating temperatures.
bobin.why2Text: 50+ standard geometries from EE13 to ETD59; EFD, PQ, RM, EP and toroidal forms.
bobin.why3Text: Horizontal and vertical mounting options, SMD-compatible variants, and various pin pitch configurations.
bobin.why4Text: Custom order production with non-standard window sizes, pin placement, or flange geometry.
bobin.type1Desc: EE13, EE16, EE19, EE25, EE30, EE42, EE55 — Most common series for SMPS and LED transformers.
bobin.type2Desc: ETD29, ETD34, ETD39, ETD44, ETD49, ETD59 — High power density applications.
bobin.type3Desc: EFD15, EFD20, EFD25, EFD30 — Thin profile, high power density.
bobin.type4Desc: PQ20, PQ26, PQ32, PQ35, PQ40, PQ50 — Suitable for power transformers with large window area.
bobin.type5Desc: RM4, RM5, RM6, RM8, RM10, RM12 — Space-optimized for compact PCB designs.
bobin.type6Desc: Open geometry for high-power industrial transformers and reactance coils.
bobin.ctaTitle: Contact Us for a Bobbin Quote
bobin.ctaText: Choose from the standard catalog or discuss custom size and winding configurations with our technical team.

transformator.heroSubtitle: Ferrite and Laminated Transformer Manufacturing — Turkey
transformator.heroDescription: SMPS ferrite transformers, laminated power transformers, and custom-designed transformers. Artek Elektronik has been manufacturing transformers to industrial quality standards since 1987.
transformator.whatIsText: A transformer is a power electronics component that transfers energy between two or more windings through electromagnetic induction. High-frequency ferrite core transformers are used in SMPS circuits, while laminated (silicon steel) transformers are used in industrial 50/60 Hz systems.
transformator.why1Text: Efficiency rates of 96% and above through optimal core selection and winding geometry.
transformator.why2Text: Wide power range from 1 W SMPS pulsers to 10 kVA laminated transformer applications.
transformator.why3Text: Frequency, voltage, current, and dimension optimization according to customer specifications.
transformator.why4Text: Consistent quality in every batch with ISO 9001:2015 certified processes, test and verification protocols.
transformator.type1Desc: Compact size and high efficiency in switched-mode power supply transformers operating between 20 kHz – 3 MHz.
transformator.type2Desc: Silicon steel laminated transformers for 50/60 Hz industrial power systems. High power and long service life.
transformator.type3Desc: Minimum stray field with closed magnetic circuit — ideal for audio systems, medical, and precision measurement devices.
transformator.type4Desc: AEC-Q200 compliant in-vehicle power conversion transformers providing reliable operation across wide temperature ranges.
transformator.type5Desc: Isolated gate signal transfer for driving IGBTs and MOSFETs; frequency and load independence.
transformator.type6Desc: High-accuracy current transformers for precise and isolated measurement of line current.
transformator.app1: Industrial SMPS and UPS Power Supplies
transformator.ctaText: Browse our product catalog or contact our technical team for custom transformer design.
